title: Director - Product Management
jobDescription: .vc_row.wpb_row.vc_inner{padding-right:0px !important; padding-left:0px !important; } .blog-single-header-wrapper { background-color: #325887; padding: 50px 0 10px 0 !important; } .blog-single-header-wrapper h1 { color: #ffffff !important; } .blog-single-header-wrapper .entry-meta span { color: #ffffff; } .blog-single-title{ text-align: center; } #breadcrumbs {background-color:#f9f9f9; padding:8px; margin-bottom:0px !important;} .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:113px;} @media (min-width: 1025px) and (max-width: 1280px) { .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:113px !important;} } @media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1024px) { .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:0px !important;} } @media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1024px) and (orientation: landscape) { .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:0px !important;} } @media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 767px) { .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:0px !important;} } @media (min-width: 320px) and (max-width: 480px) { .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:0px !important;} } About Simplify Healthcare Simplify Healthcare, a Simplify Group company, is a leading healthcare technology company focused on transforming how U.S. health plans (Payers) operate across benefits, provider, and claims functions. We build cloud-based, AI-driven SaaS platforms that modernize core payer workflows and enable scalable, complaint, and efficient operations. Our flagship platform, Simplify Health Cloud™ brings together enterprise-grade solutions for product configuration, benefits administration, provider lifecycle management, claims operations, and experience orchestration. Designed specifically for the U.S. health insurance ecosystem, our platforms support real-world regulatory complexity, operational scale, and continuous change. Headquartered in Chicago with a Global Development & Delivery Center in Pune and a global workforce of 900+ professionals, Simplify Healthcare supports more than 70 U.S. health plans. We are a bootstrapped, debt-free organization with over 18 years of profitable growth, combining long-term stability with a strong execution culture. As we enter our next phase of growth, we continue to invest in applied AI, platform modernization, and leadership talent to shape the future of payer technology. About the Role We are looking for a strategic and execution-focused product leader to shape, scale, and modernize our healthcare payer product portfolio. This role combines product vision, business ownership, AI-driven innovation, and operational excellence - requiring a leader who can think long-term while delivering measurable business outcomes in the near term. As Director - Product Management, you will lead strategic product initiatives across healthcare payer workflows while partnering with executive leadership, customers, engineering, architecture, UX, analytics, AI teams, and go-to-market organizations to define the future of our platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong healthcare payer expertise, enterprise SaaS product leadership, business acumen, and a passion for AI-enabled digital transformation. What You Will Own Product Vision, Strategy & Roadmap Define and execute a differentiated product strategy aligned to market opportunities, customer needs, and business growth objectives. Own multi-year roadmap planning and prioritization across strategic product areas. Drive innovation across the healthcare payer product portfolio leveraging AI/ML, automation, predictive analytics, and intelligent workflows. Identify opportunities to modernize payer operations through digital transformation and AI-enabled capabilities. Ensure platform scalability, usability, configurability, and operational excellence. AI & Digital Transformation Leadership Drive adoption of Generative AI, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and decision-support capabilities across payer workflows. Partner with AI, analytics, engineering, and architecture teams to define scalable AI-driven product solutions. Evaluate emerging industry trends related to AI-enabled healthcare platforms, interoperability, workflow modernization, and operational automation. Champion responsible AI principles including governance, explainability, security, compliance, and healthcare data privacy. Lead transformation initiatives that improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and business outcomes. Leadership & Team Building Build, mentor, and lead high-performing Product Managers and cross-functional product teams. Establish a strong product culture focused on customer outcomes, accountability, innovation, collaboration, and measurable impact. Coach and develop next-generation product leaders with strong business and healthcare domain expertise. Foster a proactive, execution-oriented, and data-driven decision-making culture. Drive organizational product maturity, product operating models, and best practices. End-to-End Product Lifecycle Ownership Drive product development from concept → strategy → execution → launch → adoption → optimization. Partner closely with Engineering, UX, QA, Architecture, and Delivery teams to deliver high-quality enterprise SaaS products. Own prioritization decisions balancing customer value, scalability, technical investments, and business impact. Ensure timely delivery of releases while maintaining quality, compliance, security, and operational readiness. Oversee release communication, demos, training enablement, and product adoption strategies. Market, Customer & Domain Leadership Leverage deep healthcare payer expertise across Benefits, Claims, Prior Authorization, Provider, Member, and Clinical workflows. Build strong executive-level relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. Conduct market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and customer research to identify product opportunities. Translate complex healthcare business requirements into scalable platform capabilities and configurable product solutions. Bring customer-centric thinking into all product decisions by understanding operational pain points, user journeys, and adoption challenges. Business Ownership & Growth Own product-level growth metrics including ACV, adoption, customer satisfaction, retention, and platform expansion opportunities. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Implementation teams to drive product positioning and revenue growth. Support strategic customer engagements, executive presentations, roadmap discussions, and pre-sales initiatives. Influence investment decisions through strong business cases, market insights, and product strategy alignment. Drive measurable business outcomes through product innovation and operational transformation. Cross-Platform & Global Collaboration Collaborate across multiple product ecosystems and enterprise platform initiatives. Work effectively across global teams, stakeholders, and delivery organizations. Drive alignment across Product, Engineering, GTM, Operations, Customer Success, and partner ecosystems. Influence cross-functional decision-making in a fast-paced and evolving business environment. What We are Looking For 15+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Leadership, Consulting, or Healthcare Technology leadership roles. Proven experience leading enterprise SaaS products, product organizations, and large-scale platform initiatives. Deep expertise in U.S. healthcare payer domain including Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial, ACA, Claims, Benefits, Provider, and Authorization workflows. Strong understanding of healthcare payer operations, interoperability, utilization management, and claims adjudication workflows. Experience driving digital transformation, AI-enabled product innovation, or workflow automation initiatives. Exposure to AI/ML-driven products, analytics platforms, intelligent automation, or Generative AI capabilities preferred. Strong business acumen with experience owning product growth metrics and strategic business outcomes. Experience working with cloud platforms and modern enterprise architecture (preferably Microsoft Azure). Excellent executive presence, communication, storytelling, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and lead through ambiguity and organizational change. Proven ability to operate effectively in high-growth, fast-paced, and highly collaborative environments. Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent required. Healthcare domain expertise preferred / good to have. Why This Role Matters This is a mission-critical leadership role that will shape the future of Simplify’s AI-enabled healthcare payer platform portfolio. You will directly influence product innovation, digital transformation strategy, customer outcomes, market positioning, and revenue growth while partnering closely with executive leadership and global healthcare customers. If you have any questions, please direct your inquiries to careers@simplifyhealthcare.com 

title: Product Manager
jobDescription: .vc_row.wpb_row.vc_inner{padding-right:0px !important; padding-left:0px !important; } .blog-single-header-wrapper { background-color: #325887; padding: 50px 0 10px 0 !important; } .blog-single-header-wrapper h1 { color: #ffffff !important; } .blog-single-header-wrapper .entry-meta span { color: #ffffff; } .blog-single-title{ text-align: center; } #breadcrumbs {background-color:#f9f9f9; padding:8px; margin-bottom:0px !important;} .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:113px;} @media (min-width: 1025px) and (max-width: 1280px) { .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:113px !important;} } @media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1024px) { .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:0px !important;} } @media (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1024px) and (orientation: landscape) { .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:0px !important;} } @media (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 767px) { .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:0px !important;} } @media (min-width: 320px) and (max-width: 480px) { .single-post .entry-header.blog-header {padding-top:0px !important;} } Role: Simplify Healthcare is the leader in healthcare payer Digital Business Transformation and is looking to build a team of sharp, detail-oriented, self-motivated change agents and domain experts who will enable and improve the digital transformation of fundamental business operations. Define the product vision and create a product roadmap aligned with business goals and market opportunities. Manage the product backlog by anticipating client needs and prioritizing features that deliver measurable business value. Drive product innovation objectives and release content (release notes, product documentation updates, demos, and training artifacts) via prioritized features following Agile best practices. As a Product Manager, you will partner with business, operations, engineering, architecture, UX, analytics, and AI teams throughout the product lifecycle, including vision, requirements, deployment, optimization, and adoption. You are expected to have a strong understanding of healthcare payer systems, workflows, claims operations, and competitive industry offerings while identifying opportunities to modernize processes through AI-enabled capabilities and intelligent automation. The ideal candidate will combine healthcare payer expertise, product management discipline, strategic thinking, customer-centricity, and emerging AI product capabilities to help shape the next generation of digital healthcare solutions. Responsibilities: Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap aligned with organizational priorities and client objectives. Translate healthcare payer operational challenges into scalable digital and AI-enabled product solutions. Drive product consistency, usability, scalability, and innovation across the platform. Identify opportunities to leverage AI/ML, automation, predictive analytics, generative AI, and intelligent workflows to improve operational efficiency and customer experience. Own and manage the product backlog by balancing customer needs, technical priorities, business objectives, and market opportunities. Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX, QA, analytics, and AI teams to deliver high-quality products and enhancements. Facilitate requirement gathering, prioritization, sprint planning, story refinement, and release planning following Agile best practices. Collaborate with technical teams to evaluate AI-assisted workflows, intelligent automation, decision-support models, and data-driven product capabilities. Ensure timely delivery of product releases while maintaining quality, scalability, security, and compliance standards. Support release readiness through documentation, release notes, demos, training materials, and stakeholder communication. Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, clients, implementation teams, and executive leadership. Act as the bridge between business and technology teams to ensure alignment and execution clarity. Lead product discussions with clients to understand business goals, operational pain points, and transformation opportunities. Communicate product direction, tradeoffs, priorities, and business impact effectively across technical and non-technical audiences. Influence prioritization decisions through strong analytical thinking, negotiation, and stakeholder management. Anticipate risks, identify blockers early, and proactively drive resolution. Mentor and guide Business Analysts, Product Consultants, Associate Product Managers, and operational teams. Promote a culture of ownership, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and accountability. Drive proactive problem solving rather than reactive issue management. Foster cross-functional alignment and ensure clarity of product direction across teams. Contribute to organizational product maturity, AI transformation initiatives, and best practices. Healthcare Domain & Product Expertise Develop deep expertise in healthcare payer workflows including benefits, claims, prior authorization, provider, member, and clinical data. Understand healthcare interoperability standards, payer operations, utilization management, and claims adjudication workflows. Translate healthcare business requirements into scalable platform capabilities and configurable product features. Evaluate feature fitment between standard product functionality and client-specific customization requirements. Bring customer-centric thinking into all product decisions by understanding user workflows, operational pain points, and adoption challenges. AI & Digital Transformation Expectations As part of Simplify Healthcare’s AI-enabled product transformation journey, Product Managers are expected to: Identify opportunities for Generative AI, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and predictive analytics within healthcare payer workflows. Partner with AI, data science, and engineering teams to define AI-driven product use cases and measurable business outcomes. Understand responsible AI principles including explainability, governance, security, compliance, and healthcare data privacy. Drive AI-assisted user experiences that improve operational productivity, decision-making, and customer engagement. Evaluate market trends related to AI-enabled healthcare platforms, digital experience modernization, and workflow automation. Champion adoption of AI-powered product capabilities across clients and internal teams. Requirements: 10-15 years of relevant experience, including product management experience in healthcare technology, payer platforms, or healthcare informatics. Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent required. Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, and digital product delivery. Experience working with healthcare data models, operational workflows, and enterprise platform products. Exposure to AI/ML-driven products, analytics platforms, workflow automation, or digital transformation initiatives preferred. Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and executive communication skills. Strong stakeholder management, leadership, negotiation, and influencing skills. Proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale products, process transformation initiatives, and cross-functional programs. Experience collaborating with engineering, UX, architecture, implementation, and client success teams. Ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving, and highly collaborative environments. Knowledge & understanding of healthcare payer ecosystems including claims, benefits, provider, member, authorization, and clinical workflows. Healthcare domain knowledge is preferred / good to have. If you have any questions, please direct your inquiries to careers@simplifyhealthcare.com

With deep domain and technology expertise, we have built market-leading solutions around Product, Benefits, and Provider lifecycle management. Our flagship platform, Simplify Health Cloud™ , positions us as a leader in SaaS-based enterprise healthcare solutions. Headquartered in Chicago with a Global Delivery Centre in Pune and 800+ FTEs, we work with 65+ Payer customers and continue to be recognized in Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500™, the Inc. 5000 list, IDC, and Gartner reports. Role Overview We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Project Manager with a strong background in the Healthcare domain to lead projects across diverse healthcare initiatives along with compliance driven data management solutions. The ideal candidate will possess solid experience in managing Delivery, Operations, and Production Support clients, coupled with expertise in managing large-scale healthcare projects, ensuring seamless delivery and client satisfaction. The candidate should possess strong expertise in project management processes, tracking Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and delivering results in a deadline-driven environment. This role requires exceptional leadership skills, strategic thinking, familiarity with healthcare standards/regulations, and a collaborative mindset to ensure successful project execution. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end configuration project lifecycle, from planning to final delivery including YoY maintenance and support ensuring timely and quality delivery. Serve as the primary point of contact for clients with production support needs. Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve production system issues promptly. Oversee ticket resolution workflows, ensuring timely responses and minimal downtime. Track and report production support metrics, such as system uptime, issue resolution times, and customer satisfaction levels. Use root cause analysis (RCA) to identify trends and proactively prevent recurring issues. Create and maintain detailed project plans, timelines, and progress reports. Work closely with cross-functional teams, functional business analysts, client delivery and Product teams to achieve project objectives. Manage client escalations effectively in production environments and provide timely updates on issue resolution. Define, monitor, and analyse project Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for production support processes to track overall project performance. Proactively identify opportunities to optimize production workflows and enhance system performance. Oversee quality assurance processes, including review cycles. Maintain accurate project documentation and reporting for leadership visibility. Lead and motivate project teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and ownership. Conduct performance reviews and identify training needs to enhance team competencies. Ideal Candidate Profile 8-12 years of experience in project management , preferably in managing Production support processes and healthcare compliance. Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructures and production support technologies, like monitoring tools , incident tracking systems , and automation tools . Proven experience in onboarding, hiring coordination, quality reviews, assignments, project management and reporting. Strong organizational skills with ability to manage multiple, complex projects simultaneously. Strong excel skills preferred and familiarity with Azure Devops is a strong plus. Exposure to US healthcare or compliance documentation highly desirable. Familiarity with emerging healthcare technologies such as AI in healthcare or data interoperability. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. PMP/Prince2/Agile certification preferred but not mandatory. Based in Pune with hybrid work culture; flexibility to overlap with US business hours required. What We Offer Opportunity to build and scale a new practice area within a fast-growing healthcare technology company. Exposure to global stakeholders and US healthcare compliance standards. Remote-first flexibility with strong collaboration culture. Competitive compensation, healthcare benefits, and professional development opportunities. A high-performance, growth-driven work environment. If you have any questions, please direct your inquiries to careers@simplifyhealthcare.com
